key_catalyst: US-Iran shipping blockade announcement and oil surging above $86
reasoning: Despite a highly favorable CPI print and a semiconductor rebound, QQQ closed flat as the market temporarily shrugged off a severe escalation in US-Iran tensions, including a new shipping blockade and oil surging past $86. Given that lesser geopolitical fears triggered a 1.9% selloff yesterday, the market's failure to price in this escalating conflict and spiking energy costs leaves QQQ vulnerable to an overnight gap-down if the blockade disrupts supply chains or sparks retaliation.
